name: suite-is-product-source
body: `opencode-suite/**` is product source: the tool files and the shared lib are embedded into the `apg` binary via `include_str!` in `rust.apg.install` (`src/install.rs`, whose plugin registry carries the `apg_plan_phases.ts` entry) and installed by `apg init` into `~/.config/opencode/plugins/` (the tool plugins) and `~/.config/opencode/lib/apg.ts` (the shared lib). The repo's own `.opencode/**` are consumer artifacts regenerated out-of-band from the installed release and are never edited here. Satisfaction is assessed by review.
